Name: Inference Monitor
Description: Live usage limits and balances for your inference providers, with a Provider Switch key that cycles the providers you choose.

Actions.Name: Provider Tile
Actions.Tooltip: Show a limit/balance metric of the active provider — place one Primary and one Secondary

Actions.Name: Provider Switch
Actions.Tooltip: Cycle the active provider — the Provider Tiles follow it

Localization.TileHint: Place two Provider Tiles next to a Provider Switch: set one to Primary and one to Secondary. Add a third Monthly tile for OpenCode Go's monthly limit. Tiles render the provider selected by the switch — usage windows for Claude, OpenAI, Ollama Cloud & OpenCode Go; balance & spend for OpenRouter & Nous.
Localization.SwitchHint: Run inf-agent on the host that holds your provider keys (see the project README) and enter its address, e.g. http://100.x.y.z:9890 over Tailscale. Tick providers to include them, use the arrows to set their cycle order, or reset to all; the Provider Tiles follow the active selection.
